author: Claude, at Omri's request (2026-10-06): external generalization of the Monday candidate methods

omri_decisions.access: Label-free refit on each external target cell (same per-cell transductive fitting as the Monday development protocol).
omri_decisions.scope: Full panel: 4 registered methods (+HEM_MOM_ga) x 8 banks + equal-weight controls + step-index reference; all results reported.
omri_decisions.highlight: B16, fixed from development data before any external result of these methods is opened (results/monday_presentation_panels_v1/run_20261006/PROTOCOL.json).

exposure: Hard2Verify and Socratic-PRMBench labels were opened in earlier rounds (Steps 433, 444-446, 459). This run is an EXPLORATORY transfer test of methods developed on PRMBench/ProcessBench; it is not untouched confirmation. MedPRMBench stays reserved and is not touched.
features: .worktrees/ssl-pseudolabel-residual-v1/results/external_banks_v4/<cell>/FEATURES.npz (56 channels; source parity gate PASS); empty steps are excluded from fitting and predicted 'error' (0) as in algorithm_external_v1.
bank_construction: algorithm_external_v1 build_bank (answer z-score; digits masked answer z; lf__ sign from POOL_STRUCTURE r_level_marginal), then the Monday variant_bank per-cell lf__ re-orientation against the 5-channel LEVEL mean.

fitting.code: Codex's frozen functions: monday_fusion_core.fit_content (DS filter, L-SML partition + merge, MEAN/HEM within, EQ/MOM between on group votes with per-answer quota = '_ga'); channel votes with per-cell quota via quota_marks(..., True) + between_weights('MOM', channel_votes=...) = '_cc'; TCI_ONLY_ga per tci_wide_stage1 (Prop 2.4 triplets in groups with >= 4 members, MoM between).
fitting.tie_keys: New external keys with the development seeds: per-bank channel keys rng(20260928).random((S_cell, m)); group keys rng(20260929).random((S_cell, 13)); TCI anchor keys rng(1000*bank_index + cell_index) with cell_index 0,1,2 in the order above.
fitting.labels: Never read by the scoring script. Labels live only in scratch/external_generalization_private/inputs/evaluator_only and are opened by the evaluation script after predictions are sealed.

source_parity_gate: Before external scoring, the same adapter applied to the SOURCE PRMBench cell (source FEATURES.npz) must reproduce the frozen development MEAN_MOM_ga / HEM_MOM_ga / DS_FILTER_EQ step scores for every bank within 1e-6, and the channels_cell and TCI scores within 1e-6; otherwise stop.

reference: earlier sealed external references ct7, frozen_lsml, frozen_equal copied by uid (continuity rows)

decision_rules.ANSWER_Z_Q80: primary threshold rule: flag iff answer-z >= 0.8 quantile of the cell's own answer-z scores (no labels)
decision_rules.R2_COUNT: Monday R2 count rule with raw survivor values from FEATURES
decision_rules.TOP_1: equal-budget control (one flagged step per answer)
decision_rules.ENTROPY_GATE_Q80: NOT RUN: requires answer-level mean top-15 token entropy, not extracted for the external cells in this stage (declared limitation)

metrics.hard2verify: official step Balanced F1 (official evaluator replay)
metrics.socratic: official PRMScore (official evaluator replay incl. categories)
metrics.both: within-answer AUC; top-1 step is an annotated error; F1 on correct / error steps
metrics.never: average Hard2Verify and Socratic official metrics

dev_vs_external.table: for every method/control x bank: development PRMBench within-AUC and PRMScore (ANSWER_Z_Q80) vs each external cell
dev_vs_external.rank_transfer: Spearman correlation across the 72 (bank x scorer) configurations between development PRMBench within-AUC and each external cell's within-AUC; also for 'method minus DS_FILTER_EQ' gains (sign agreement count)
dev_vs_external.highlight_transfer: rank of the pre-declared B16 configurations among all external configurations

statistics.contrasts: B16 methods minus DS_FILTER_EQ, minus STEP_INDEX (within-AUC only), minus frozen_lsml; descriptive 95% percentile, no winner selection

hard2verify_balanced_f1.note: paper numbers; PRM thresholds tuned on target responses

seal: Scoring writes PREDICTIONS_UNSEALED.json per cell and SCORING_STATUS.json with external_labels_opened=false and the hashes of this protocol and the scoring script; evaluation refuses to run if either changed.
